item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Plastic Machete Sheath
item_short_desc: Safeguard your machete outdoors with Rothco’s 18-inch Plastic Machete Sheath. The pistol belt clip secures to belts, bags, and more for easy access. The built-in sharpener keeps your blade sharp in the field for optimal cutting performance. In addition, the tough hard shell plastic material provides long-lasting durability and years of reliable use. From the jungle to an extended trek into the mountains, this sheath ensures that your machete is always ready for action in the wilderness.
